title: Feedback & issues
successBody: We've received it and will review it soon. If you left a contact email, we'll reply there.
savedBody: Your feedback was saved successfully, but we couldn't send it by email. The team will still see it when reviewing the history. If you want to make sure it arrives, you can copy it and send it manually:
intro: Found a bug or have an idea for an improvement? Tell us about it. We'll save it and it's automatically sent to the team's email.
